contracts.name: Synthetic Spatial Chronicle publication, multi-device adventure and gated owner trials

experienceIntent.objective: Create a spatial clue and understand the experience a Player will receive
experienceIntent.visibleOutcome: Published scenes reach a representative Player Lens with truthful capability tiers and accessible fallback
experienceIntent.persona: A Creator or Player completing the named human objective
experienceIntent.accessibility: Provide keyboard/touch operation and a meaningful supported alternate experience.

baselineDebt.deficiency: Creator preview and Player entity controls do not by themselves establish one coherent spatial clue experience.

experienceIntent.limitation: This campaign defines the required experience and tracks existing debt; it does not implement Spatial Experience Refit.

experience.persona: A Creator authoring a real spatial scene with assistance and ordinary editor controls
experience.objective: Use a coherent blue Spatial Studio, preserve the scene while opening assistance, and return to the Creator Library
experience.visibleOutcome: Light appearance covers the authoring shell and synthetic environment; overlay assistance preserves the viewport and canonical authoring controls
experience.accessibility: Keyboard entry and visible focus reach assistance, docking and return; readable themes and reduced motion retain meaning.
experience.fallback: Without a configured credential or AI allowance, ordinary authoring and guided placement controls remain available.
experience.navigation: Creator Library opens Spatial Studio; assistance overlays the scene; closing and returning restores the ordinary Creator Library.
experience.designTarget: Use an entirely light or dark blue authoring workspace with separated title/status, clear populated dock sections, and an assistant overlay that never shrinks the canvas.

references.reason: Accepted public entry establishes hierarchy and a coherent shell around distinct role destinations.
references.preserve: Visible account access, clear destinations, cinematic composition and a usable reduced-motion equivalent.

references.reason: Accepted constrained gateway keeps the same destinations and account access.
references.preserve: Mobile task hierarchy, readable controls and contextual navigation.

limitations: This bounded Creator correction does not claim a Player Lens refit, physical touch/AR acceptance, live model corpus qualification, or owner product acceptance. The protected spatial-pilot experienceIntent and its owner-reported Player debt remain unchanged.

continuity.objective: The same authenticated Creator identity survives the Studio entry, assistance review and return to the canonical Chronicle library.

motion.measurement: Visible keyboard action to rendered editor or assistance feedback

journeys.outcome: A Creator enters the actual editor, opens and docks contextual assistance, and returns to the same Creator library

steps.meaning: The natural Creator Library entry opens the usable spatial editing workspace with scene and contextual authoring actions.

steps.name: Spatial Assistant
steps.meaning: The assistance action opens a usable contextual idea composer and review area alongside the actual scene.

steps.name: Ask Parallax workspace
steps.meaning: Docking attaches contextual assistance over the existing scene while exposing an explicit return to floating assistance.

experience.persona: An authorized Admiralty operator observing daily AI spending and existing account allowances
experience.objective: Compare daily requests and costs, then inspect a user allowance through the normal People search
experience.visibleOutcome: A selectable daily chart distinguishes requests, settled cost and accounted exposure; per-user controls remain in the existing People dossier
experience.accessibility: A labeled keyboard-operable metric selector and exact daily table preserve access beyond visual bars, with visible focus and narrow-screen overflow contained.
experience.fallback: An empty month reports honest zero activity, missing provider credentials remain safely diagnosed, and read-only observation never changes quota policy.
experience.navigation: AI Usage & Quotas opens its existing chart; the canonical People navigation searches one account and returns through existing navigation.
experience.designTarget: Keep the accepted Admiralty card hierarchy and visual family, adding compact daily metrics, a clearly labeled chart selector, truthful zero bars, UTC labels and distinct settled versus reserved amounts.

references.reason: Accepted public entry establishes hierarchy and a coherent shell around distinct role destinations.
references.preserve: Visible account access, clear destinations, cinematic composition and a usable reduced-motion equivalent.

references.reason: Accepted constrained gateway keeps the same destinations and account access.
references.preserve: Mobile task hierarchy, readable controls and contextual navigation.

limitations: Isolated synthetic ledger figures exercise the actual projection and controls; they do not audit a real provider invoice or claim owner product acceptance.

journeys.outcome: An operator compares daily requests with settled and accounted costs, then restores the request chart without policy mutation

steps.name: Settled cost per day by UTC day
steps.meaning: Choosing settled cost changes the displayed daily monetary metric while keeping exact canonical request-day accounting available.

steps.name: Accounted spending per day by UTC day
steps.meaning: Choosing accounted spending distinguishes pending reservations and unresolved usage from settled costs.

steps.name: Requests per day by UTC day

journeys.outcome: The ordinary People search opens the existing account allowance controls and returns without adding a separate AI user search

steps.meaning: The selected canonical account dossier contains its real inherited AI allowance and governed per-user override controls.
